context: A police officer briefs a teen reporter on a case roster
purpose: Teach: 安倍/福田/中川/藤田/一郎/仁/隆/剛

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 今日は地域の安全教室の取材だったな。先週、近所で起きた空き巣事件の関係者を整理しておこう。
lines.en: Today's your interview for the community safety class, right? Let me walk you through the people involved in last week's neighborhood break-in.
lines.style: Calm, paternal officer easing into a low-stakes briefing for a student.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お願いします。厳密に言えば、まだ犯人は確定していないんですよね?
lines.en: Yes, please. Strictly speaking, the culprit hasn't been confirmed yet, right?
lines.style: Eager teen reporter, polite but careful with her wording.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: そうだ。目撃者として話を聞いたのが、商店街の福田さんと、隣のクリーニング店の中川さんだよ。
lines.en: That's right. The people we interviewed as witnesses are Fukuda-san from the shopping street and Nakagawa-san from the cleaners next door.
lines.style: Steady, conversational delivery, naming neighbors familiarly.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ああ、福田さんなら知っています。安倍さんのパン屋の隣ですよね。
lines.en: Ah, I know Fukuda-san. Their place is next to Abe-san's bakery, right?
lines.style: Bright recognition, the teen brightening at a familiar name.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: よく知ってるな。あとは、現場検証に立ち会ってくれた藤田さんと、町内会長の山田一郎さん。
lines.en: You know the area well. Also, Fujita-san who joined the on-site inspection, and the neighborhood association head, Yamada Ichiro-san.
lines.style: Mildly impressed, listing community contacts in even rhythm.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 一郎さんは、うちの祖父と将棋仲間なんですよ。被害は大きかったんですか?
lines.en: Ichiro-san is my grandfather's shogi buddy, actually. Was the damage serious?
lines.style: Warm personal aside, then a natural follow-up question.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 幸い軽傷で済んだ。応急処置をしてくれた看護師の鈴木仁さんと、近くを巡回中だった隆さんのおかげだな。
lines.en: Thankfully just minor injuries. We owe that to nurse Suzuki Jin-san who gave first aid, and Takashi-san who happened to be on patrol nearby.
lines.style: Warmer tone of gratitude, slowing on the names of the helpers.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 皆さん勇気がありますね。記事では、どの方の名前を出してもいいですか?
lines.en: Everyone was so brave. For the article, may I use any of their names?
lines.style: Earnest reporter checking ethics before writing, voice respectful.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本人の許可が取れた方だけにしてくれ。それと、自治会の剛さんにも一度話を聞くといい記事になるぞ。
lines.en: Only those who give consent themselves. And if you talk to Tsuyoshi-san from the residents' association, it'll make a stronger piece.
lines.style: Firm but kindly guidance, closing with practical reporting advice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。きちんと許可をいただいてから書きますね。
lines.en: Thank you. I'll make sure to get proper permission before I write anything.
lines.style: Resolved and grateful, the teen settling into quiet professionalism.
